## Row

```{python}
#| title: California AV Trips by Company and Permit Type

fig1 = px.line(
    trip_long.loc[:,['date','label','trips']], 
    x='date', 
    y='trips',
    color='label',
    color_discrete_map=company_permit_type_color_map,
    line_dash='label',
    line_dash_map=company_permit_type_dash_map,
    #height=500,
)
fig1.update_layout(
    legend=dict(
        title='',
        orientation='h'
        )
    )

#| fig-cap: *TODO*
``` 

```{python}
#| title: Driverless Deployment Trips by Company and County

fig3 = px.bar(
    trip_county_long.loc[:,['date','label','trips_start']], 
    x='date', 
    y='trips_start',
    color='label',
    color_discrete_map=company_county_color_map,
    #height=500,
).update_traces(
    dict(#marker_line_width=2.0,
         #marker_line_color=color_set_c[4],
         #marker_color=color_set_c_light[4],
         #marker_pattern_fgcolor=color_set_c[4],
         marker_pattern_fgcolor=color_set_c_light[4],
         marker_pattern_shape='/',
         opacity=0.75
        ),
    selector=({'legendgroup':'Waymo Unidentified'}),
)

fig3.update_layout(
    legend=dict(
        title='',
        orientation='h'
        )
    )
```

# Safety

## Row

```{python}
#| title: Crashes by State (and San Francisco)

px.bar(
    crash_state_sf.loc[:,['state_or_city','size']], 
    x='state_or_city', 
    y='size', 
    color='state_or_city',
    color_discrete_sequence=[
        '#d6d6d6', #'#d4c5de',
        '#ffd100',#'#e95e50',
    ] + 16 * ['#d6d6d6'],
)
```

```{python}
#| title: Crashes by City

px.pie(
    crash_city,
    names='city',
    values='size'
)
```

## Row

```{python}
#| title: Crashes by Company and Severity (California)

px.bar(
    crash_ca_comp_sev,
    x='operating_entity',
    y='size',
    color='highest_injury_severity_alleged_legacy',
    color_discrete_map= lavender_map,
    category_orders = {'highest_injury_severity_alleged_legacy':['No Injuries Reported','Minor','Moderate','Serious','Fatality','Unknown']}
)
```
